description:
**Company Overview**
 We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
   

  

**Overview**
 Are you a database expert who thrives in a fast\-paced, multi\-platform environment? As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer on our Digital \& Technology team, you will lead the migration and modernization of enterprise Microsoft SQL Server databases to the public cloud. You will administer mission\-critical SQL Server 2019 and 2022 platforms in a 24/7 environment, focusing on Availability Groups, Distributed Availability Groups, PowerShell automation, and terraform. This is your opportunity to shape cloud database engineering at a Fortune 500 company.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Lead Microsoft SQL Server migration and modernization to the public cloud.
* Migrate SQL Server workloads to GCP or other public cloud platforms.
* Own migration processes, documentation, automation, and tooling.
* Administer mission\-critical SQL Server 2019 and 2022 platforms in a 24/7 environment.
* Implement and support SQL Server Availability Groups.
* Implement and support Distributed Availability Groups.
* Perform database tuning, capacity planning, backup and recovery, patching, and upgrades.
* Use PowerShell to automate provisioning, monitoring, and support processes.
* Use Terraform to provision and manage database infrastructure in cloud environments.
* Meet cloud security standards and reduce operational and security risk.
* Collaborate with application stakeholders to resolve tickets.
* Resolve failures and critical alerts within an Agile framework.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Experience: 5\+ years administering, designing, modernizing, or migrating enterprise SQL Server databases.
* Core Technical Skills: SQL Server 2019 and 2022; Availability Groups; Distributed Availability Groups; PowerShell; and terraform.
* High Availability and Recovery: Experience with HA, DR, backup and recovery, tuning, and production support.
* Cloud Experience: Experience with cloud adoption, security, governance, and integration.
* Automation and DevOps: Experience automating provisioning, support, monitoring, and lifecycle operations with PowerShell and Terraform.
* Operating Systems: Strong Windows Server and Windows clustering experience; Linux is beneficial.
* Engineering Practices: Working knowledge of DevOps and Agile practices and proofs of concept.
* Service Orientation: Experience designing user\-centric database services, including self\-service provisioning.
* Soft Skills: Excellent communication and collaboration skills; flexible, reliable, self\-starting, and customer focused.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Cloud Database Experience: Experience operating SQL Server workloads on GCP, Azure, AWS, or other public clouds.
* Automation Tooling: Ansible, GitHub, or similar tooling; Python scripting.
* Infrastructure Engineering: CI/CD practices and automated database provisioning workflows.
* Additional Experience: Agile methods, Linux administration, and PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB.


**ELIGIBILITY**
 Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Associate Oracle DBA
description:
Your Team Responsibilities
   

  

 At MSCI, data is at the core of everything we do. We are looking for a Associate Oracle Database Administrator (DBA) to support and modernize our mission\-critical enterprise databases that power global financial products and analytics.
   

  

 This role requires deep expertise in Oracle DBA administration, performance tuning, high availability, disaster recovery, OCI Cloud, large\-scale project implementations, migrations, upgrades, and modernization initiatives and strong ownership of database operations, with readiness to support cloud and AI\-driven transformation initiatives.
   

  

 Your Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Database Administration \& Operations**
* Perform end\-to\-end Oracle DBA administration including installation, configuration, upgrades, patching, and decommissioning.
* Manage production, non\-production, and DR environments with high availability and performance.
* Handle database operations, monitoring, and 24x7 operational support as required.
* Ensure database security, compliance, and best practices.


**Performance Tuning \& Troubleshooting**
* Perform advanced performance tuning using AWR, ASH, SQL Trace, and OEM.
* Analyze execution plans, identify bottlenecks, and implement plan stability techniques.
* Develop and maintain performance tuning scripts and automation.
* Proactively troubleshoot database issues and provide root cause analysis (RCA).


**High Availability \& Disaster Recovery**
* Design, implement, and support Oracle Data Guard (Physical \& Logical Standby).
* Perform switchover/failover operations and DR drills.
* Manage RMAN backups, recovery, and restore strategies.
* Ensure RPO/RTO compliance and DR readiness.


**Cloud \& Modernization**
* Administer Oracle databases on OCI or Azure (Cloud Infrastructure)
* Support on\-prem to cloud migrations, hybrid environments, and cloud\-native architectures.


**Security \& Advanced Features**
* Implement and manage Transparent Data Encryption (TDE).
* Utilize Advanced Compression and other Oracle features for performance and storage optimization.
* Apply database security patches and vulnerability remediation.


**Project Implementation \& Migration**
* Support database projects including:
+ New database implementations
+ Version upgrades
+ Platform migrations
+ Consolidation initiatives

* Work closely with application teams, infrastructure, and cloud teams during project execution.
* Provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Technical Skills**
 Your skills and experience that will help you excel
   

  

* Strong expertise in Oracle Database Administration (19c and above).
* Hands\-on experience with:
+ Performance tuning (AWR, ASH, SQL tuning)
+ Oracle Data Guard \& Standby
+ RMAN backup and recovery
+ Database migration and upgrades

* Basic experience in scripting (Shell, SQL, PL/SQL) for automation and monitoring.
* Strong knowledge of patching strategies and lifecycle management.


**Soft Skills**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
* Ability to lead critical incidents and mentor junior DBAs.
* Proactive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Oracle Certifications (OCA / OCP / Cloud Certification).
* Experience in regulated or large enterprise environments.


**About MSCI**
**What we offer you**
* Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
* A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
* Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
* Multi\-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
* We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride \& Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.


 At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry\-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.
   

  

 MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research\-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. We serve asset managers and owners, private\-market sponsors and investors, hedge funds, wealth managers, banks, insurers and corporates.
   

  

 MSCI Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. It is the policy of the firm to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, age, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability, marital and civil partnership/union status, pregnancy (including unlawful discrimination on the basis of a legally protected parental leave), veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. MSCI is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please email Disability.Assistance@msci.com and indicate the specifics of the assistance needed. Please note, this e\-mail is intended only for individuals who are requesting a reasonable workplace accommodation; it is not intended for other inquiries.
   

  

**To all recruitment agencies**
 MSCI does not accept unsolicited CVs/Resumes. Please do not forward CVs/Resumes to any MSCI employee, location, or website. MSCI is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited CVs/Resumes.
   

  

**Note on recruitment scams**

description:
**Summary**
 We are seeking a skilled and motivated SQL Database Administrator to join our 24x7 operations team. In this role, you will be responsible for the health, performance, and availability of our critical SQL Server databases, with a strong emphasis on Always On Availability Groups (AG) and High Availability/Disaster Recovery (HADR) solutions. You will be part of a team ensuring our databases are running optimally and that we can quickly recover from any unforeseen issues.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Administer and maintain SQL Server databases on Azure, ensuring optimal performance, security, and availability.
* Implement, configure, and manage AlwaysOn Availability Groups (AG) for high availability and disaster recovery.
* Troubleshoot and resolve database performance issues, outages, and other incidents in a timely manner.
* Participate in a 24x7 on\-call rotation, responding to alerts and incidents as needed.
* Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and other teams to ensure database solutions meet business requirements.
* Develop and maintain documentation for database configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps.
* Implement and maintain database security measures, including user access controls and data encryption.
* Perform database backups and restores.
* Monitor database performance and proactively identify potential issues.
* Apply database patches and upgrades.
* Participate in capacity planning and performance tuning activities.


**Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of experience as a SQL Server Database Administrator.
* AZ\-900 certification would be added advantage
* Hands\-on experience with Always On Availability Groups (AG) or other High Availability/Disaster Recovery (HADR) solutions.
* Strong hands\-on experience with SQL Server database administration, including installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical information to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, 24x7 environment.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Experience with database monitoring tools (SentryOne/LogicMonitor/AppDynamics).
* Experience with SQL Server performance tuning.
* Experience with database security best practices.

title: Senior Consultant - SAP ABAP
description:
**Role: Senior Consultant \- SAP ABAP\-Contract Role
   

  

 Experience: 5 to 8 Years
   

  

 Location: India (Delhi/ Hyderabad/ Mumbai/ Noida/Pune)**
* Experience: 7\+ years in SAP ECC ABAP / Integration with at least 3\+ years working directly with the Proaxia FSM Connector (Proaxia FSM Integration Component).
* ALE/IDoc Expertise: In\-depth knowledge of IDoc packet processing, queue decoupling, parallel processing setups (RBDAPP01\), and qRFC tuning.
* Proaxia Expertise (Good to have): Proven track record configuring and extending Proaxia mapping tables, runtime classes, and message queues.
* Performance Tools: Proficiency with SAT, ST12, ST05 (SQL Trace), SMQ2, WE02/BD87, and DB02\.


**Responsibilities**
* IDoc \& Queue Performance: Diagnose and resolve qRFC (SMQ2\), tRFC (SM58\), and IDoc inbound queues exceeding 10\-minute thresholds. Configure packet sizing, parallel processing, and asynchronous queue execution.
* Proaxia Add\-On Tuning: Audit and tune Proaxia FSM Connector configuration settings, custom BAdI implementations, user exits, and outbound/inbound object serialization (e.g., Service Orders, Confirmations, Business Partners).
* ABAP \& Database Optimization: Trace and optimize ABAP code inside custom BAdIs or enhancement points triggered during IDoc inbound processing. Identify and mitigate database locks and table access bottlenecks.
* System Monitoring \& Logging: Rationalize logging levels within the Proaxia framework and ECC ALE layer to reduce unnecessary disk I/O and table bloat.

description:
**Job Summary:** 
 We are seeking a skilled SnapLogic Developer with 5 to 8 years of experience to design, develop, and maintain integration solutions using the SnapLogic platform. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data integration, ETL processes, and API management. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless data flow and integration across various systems.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Performing the platform or patch upgrades
* Manage user accounts, roles, and permissions within the SnapLogic platform to ensure secure and efficient access control
* Design, develop, and implement integration solutions using the SnapLogic platform.
* Collaborate with business analysts, data architects, and other stakeholders to understand integration requirements and translate them into technical specifications.

* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
